closure: The actual installed ConcavePolygonShape3D Resource.changed signal now invalidates the dictionary shared with the registered face-range map. resolve_source_hit refuses invalidated mappings before any lookup. A same-resource set_faces mutation is exercised natively and rejected. No per-query face hashing/caching workaround introduced.
exact_representation: Batched collision now expands through ArrayMesh.get_faces(), the same native representation as defaultcreate_trimesh_shape. The original byte-exact comparisons remain in QA and pass for aggregate and split shapes. No approximate epsilon was substituted.
prior_nonblocking_observation_withdrawn: The per-feature ArrayMesh is now intentionally required for canonical native collision representation; do not remove it based on the prior allocation observation without equivalent byte-native proof.
